verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a SaaS equity and fund platform, but the evidence shows no way to operate AngelList through natural-language commands. Every documented workflow is click-based UI navigation. The AI Tie Out Assistant only flags cap-table mismatches, which is an adjacent feature rather than a command interface. The llms.txt file is help-center documentation for LLMs, not a way to operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
